title: Jensen Huang to testify before Congress on ‘potential breach of national security’
summary_full: High-stakes hearing comes in wake of resignation from Nvidia after alleged affair with suspected Chinese spyNvidia’s former CEO Jensen Huang will testify before several congressional committees on 1 December, setting the stage for a high-stakes hearing in the wake of his resignation following an affair with a suspected Chinese spy.Tim Teter, Nvidia’s general counsel, has also agreed to appear for a closed-door transcribed interview the following day, 2 December.
